description: Resource schema for AWS::IoTSiteWise::Task. A task defines a reusable containerized compute workload that can be referenced by one or more pipeline compute nodes.

TaskConfiguration.markdownDescription:
The task execution configuration.

Required: No  
Update requires: No interruption

EcrUri.markdownDescription:

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 1024  
Pattern: ^((\d{12}\.dkr\.ecr\.[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z.]+)|public\.ecr\.aws/[a-z][a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*)/[a-z0-9]+((\.||__|__|-+)[a-z0-9]+)*(/[a-z0-9]+((\.||__|__|-+)[a-z0-9]+)*)*(:[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+|@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})?$
